item.title: West, R. Donaldson announce candidacy - Metter Advertiser
item.description: When qualifying ended on Friday, March 6, both County Commission incumbents had qualified without opposition. However, in the Board of Education race, both Districts 2 and 4 face opposition. item.title: Work underway on local railway - Metter Advertiser
item.description: Construction is underway on the Metter–Register Rail Upgrades Project led by Candler County Industrial Authority and supported by Georgia Southern Railway (GS), a $1.4 million federally-supported initiative that has completed all planning and design milestones. Construction activities include track rehabilitation, grade crossing improvements, culvert upgrades and repairs, and bridge repairs. These improvements are scheduled for completion in early Q4 2026 […]
